::: {.div style="font-size:2em;"}
Welcome to Year 2 statistics!
:::

This year you will have the opportunity to build on the skills you developed last year - both in terms of research design and statistical expertise and data coding in R. This year, you will complete two statistics modules: 

- PSYC5141: Experimental Methods for Psychology, with Mark Hurlstone (coordinator), Patrick May, Emma Mills, and Chris Walton

- PSYC5242: Qualitative and Quantitative Methods for Psychology, with Emma Mills (coordinator) Jared Piazza and Chris Walton

Click on the button below to access your module: Term 1: PSYC5141, Term 2: PSYC5242.
